1.1 Central idea

The supplied parent construction is treated as a safe anchor on the feasible manifold. The core search is a constrained, low-dimensional latent-space global refinement method, called Parent-Anchored Latent Subspace Differential Evolution (PAL-SDE). Instead of treating the full n-dimensional vector directly as the main decision variable, the program searches a small coefficient vector \(b\) whose decode operation changes many coordinates of a locally scaled basis field and then imposes both constraints exactly by a joint feasibility projection.

For a current anchor vector \(h_0\in[0,1]^n\) with \(\sum_i h_i=n/2\), and a mode basis \(B\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}\), define

\[
z(b)=h_0+\sigma B b,
\]

followed by the exact jointly feasible projection

\[
h(b)=\Pi_{\mathbb{F}}(z(b)), \qquad 
\mathbb{F}=\{h\in[0,1]^n : \sum_i h_i=n/2\}.
\]

Because \(h(0)=h_0\) exactly when \(h_0\) is already feasible, every objectives evaluation is automatically conservative: moving away from the parent coordinate direction may produce a new feasible step function, but the latent coordinate starting point remains the original parent without projection damage. The baseline acceptance rule is always based on exact evaluation by the official evaluator. The parent or a constant feasible fallback is retained as the final good fallback if no improvement is found.

This is materially different from the earlier approaches because it is not primarily:
- a smoothed log-sum-exp optimization followed by SLSQP;
- an active-set linear programming model generated from local gradients;
- a search over exact one-dimensional polynomial moves on the original coordinates.

Here the main search primitive is a low-dimensional nondifferentiable constrained vector move. One coefficient vector changes many positions according to smooth modes, while exact feasibility changes many entries near saturation boundaries at once. Boundary overlap accuracy can change jointly instead of through coordinate directions or smoothed objective worries. The mechanism can modify the correlation landscape globally while sacrificing derivative accessibility, hence differential evolution and optional derivative-free local phase are used.
